source_document: Mastercard Contactless Testing Environment (CTEL2) Version 4.1 Level 2 Reader Testing, 2025-06-17
structure_source: MastercardHost/Config runtime artifact (Config/<id>.json: AIDParam rows keyed by 9F06 x 9C x 9F2A, plus TermParam); AID/<id>.xml only completes rows that the runtime artifact is missing

capk.source: Appendix B PAGE 66-71 (Table 29 RID A000000004, Table 30 RID B012345678)
capk.note: DF03 is the checksum printed in Appendix B, re-verified as SHA1(9F06||9F22||DF02||DF04) at import time. The wider ICS key list prints further indexes for these RIDs (A000000004:05, A000000004:F7, A000000004:F8, A000000004:FA, B012345678:05, B012345678:F7, B012345678:F8); this document defines none of them, so they are not imported.
notes: capk index 01 is a locally generated test CA key for 3C05-9100-06 (CDA): the reference card names CTEL2 Appendix B index F3, whose private key is not available

deliberately_absent.drl: ruling: a Mastercard CONF carries no DRL (CTEL2 Table 13 is not imported)
deliberately_absent.deds: ruling: the DEDS (Data Exchange) family and DEDS-only data objects are out of scope

proprietary_action_tags.DF8308: tags to add with zero length (reference-private)
proprietary_action_tags.DF8309: tags to remove from the kernel TLV database (reference-private)
proprietary_action_tags.DF830A: complete TLV(s) to add to the kernel TLV database (reference-private)

doc_conflicts: Table 17 PAGE 41 (PPS_MStripe1): 'All other data items not listed in table Default Configuration Data - Mag-Stripe must be absent'. The same table's deltas then change the Terminal/Reader Contactless floor limit, an object the Mag-Stripe default table does not list; the reference runtime keeps 9F09/9F1B/9F1D/DF11-DF13/DF19/DF20/DF32-DF36 on Mag-Stripe configs, and they are kept here (rubric: keep reference-only objects unless the document states a value).

PPS_MCnoDefault_1..5 (PAGE 52): the referenced table 'Configuration Data in TLV Database that Require Default Value' (with its Implementations column) is not printed in CTEL2 v4.1; only the Mag-Stripe 'Always' rows (PAGE 43) are available. The Always-class objects are removed as the document requires; the 'EMV' class follows the reference runtime, which drops them too.

PPS_MCnoDefault_2..5 re-add Reader CTL / Reader CVM Required Limit objects that PPS_MCnoDefault_1 forbids; the per-config delta wins (documented as an intentional override, not a contradiction to resolve here).
9F33 Terminal Capability ('Tag not present' in Table 16 PAGE 39) is kept where the reference runtime carries it, per the ruling to keep reference-only objects.
PPS_perf_MC / TermSettingC-2 (PAGE 54): the C-8 kernel test configuration 'C8_prof01' lives in EMVCo's ReaderConfs.xmd and has no kernel data object in this library.
